**Verdict: Very worried—existential risk.** Three compounding failure modes: (1) YT constantly A/B tests silent DOM changes; (2) Chrome Web Store (CWS) review delays hotfixes by hrs–days, & Manifest V3 bans remote code; (3) Google owns both YT & CWS, so ToS enforcement kills 80% of acquisition overnight.

### 1. Survive DOM breaks (next 2 weeks)
* **Remote selector config:** Move all CSS/XPath selectors, fallback chains, & kill switches to a remotely fetched JSON file (strictly data—no eval/logic—to stay MV3-compliant). Turns multi-day CWS review into 5-min fix.
* **Harden targeting:** Stop binding to obfuscated classes or deep DOM paths. Use fallback arrays prioritizing ARIA labels, semantic elements, & stable attributes. Where feasible, read YT's structured page objects (`ytInitialData`, `ytInitialPlayerResponse`) instead of visual DOM.
* **Canaries + telemetry:** Run hourly headless Playwright/Puppeteer checks against live YT (logged-in + logged-out). Log client-side selector miss rates to catch silent YT A/B rollouts before 1-star reviews hit.
* **Graceful degradation:** On selector miss, fail silently & hide UI rather than breaking YT playback/layout.

### 2. Decouple product from YT (months 1–3)
* **Offload scraping:** Move anything possible (metadata, search, channel data) to official YT Data API or backend.
* **Thin the extension:** Turn extension into capture/entry trigger; push core value + retention into your own web app.
* **Capture owned identity early:** Convert installs to accounts/emails immediately so a takedown doesn't strand your active base.

### 3. De-risk the 80% channel (quarters 1–2)
* **Non-extension funnel:** Ship a standalone web entry point (e.g., paste-YT-URL tool + SEO, creator partnerships) targeting <50% acquisition from extension.
* **ToS audit:** If extension interferes w/ YT ads, downloads, or monetization, expect eventual CWS takedown—strip or isolate those features.
* **Cross-browser port:** Ship on Firefox/Edge/Safari (low marginal cost w/ WebExtensions); hedges CWS ban, though not YT DOM breaks.
